name: Open the swap-routing settings screen
description: Opens the swap-routing preferences screen from Settings and checks its options appear with sensible defaults for a new user, then returns to the wallet — proving the screen opens without crashing.
details: From Settings, the Swap routing row opens the routing-preferences screen and its rows render for a fresh user with defaults — Min transfer amount (Rebalancing), Max intermediaries (Middleman Routing) — proving this previously-untested settings route lands without crash; back to wallet. (Section titles are CSS-uppercased so anchor on the mixed-case content rows, not the section headers)
